crossRefs.note: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

people.name: Elizaphan
people.line: A Levite leader from the Kohathite clan.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Uzziel
people.line: Son of Kohath, uncle of Moses and Aaron

translations.web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
translations.bsb: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
translations.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
translations.asv: And the prince of the fathers' house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
